description: Return the most recent fact operations across all agents in this tenant, newest first. Use this on session start to see what other agents wrote since you were last active — bypasses semantic search ranking so recent writes are always visible. Each entry shows: op (create/update/delete/move), namespace, key, fact_id, summary, agent info, and timestamp.

since_seq.description: Only return entries with seq > this value (for pagination)

name: index_recent
title: Recent Activity Index
